The supported selected Binary/WAHex AST closure now has no unresolved diagnostics; caller reachability, alternate variants and full application behavior remain outside this static scope. No new exhaustive execution claim is made.
Custom Base32 is the shipped non-RFC alphabet; this suite does not assert server acceptance of linking codes.
